document.abstract: Sound Inn S is a television program on Tokyo Broadcasting System, Inc. and its affiliated stations throughout the country from 11:00 to 11:30 p.m. every Sunday evening. This show is so popular that it was featured in Japan Tonight, a gala television event telecast in April, 1980 by station WOR in New York City, introducing hundreds of thousands of Americans to what TV is like in Japan.

authors.affiliation: Tokyo Broadcasting System, Inc., Akasaka, Tokyo, Japan
authors.bio: Kiyomi Iizuka is a graduate of the University of Electro-Communication, and began his career with Tokyo Broadcasting, Inc. as a sound engineer in 1954. In 1964 he was transferred from the radio to the television division. Today he is a studio sound engineer for development and production works.
